priority: OLE2/OOXML first; ODF deferred until the OLE2/OOXML optimization goal completes.
hypothesis: The valid source-backed XLSX path has a performance cliff near its bounded shared-traversal boundary; a fresh size sweep must show that the candidate stays within a small matched baseline envelope before retention.
scope: Supplemental valid-path cap-boundary refusal guard for the 0544 XLSX candidate. This lane never changes the main native, allocation, refusal, profile, eager, or hardware gates.
native_order: retained baseline repeat 2 under candidate source checkout

cap_boundary.timing_scope: Fresh child /usr/bin/time surrounds the guard; guard phase reports edit_sheets planning only, with fixture construction, open, selector setup, and correctness checks outside its phase clock.
cap_boundary.performance_claim: valid planning p50 and mean diagnostic gate only

admission: For every size and repeat, candidate planning p50 and mean must be no greater than 1.05 times the matched baseline. Every candidate increase above 5% and every same-build repeat drift above 5% receives an individual review. A missing or malformed fixture/report, semantic failure, or source identity mismatch rejects the lane. This stricter supplemental valid guard does not alter the main frozen gates.

temporary_enabler.purpose: Retained benchmark example, identical both builds; no production API

source_binding: Baseline and candidate freeze the complete source manifest. The cap example is present in both manifests as a temporary enabler; the only candidate diff permitted by candidate_files is the original five implementation/test files. Shared source-backed integration tests remain byte-identical in both stages.

guard.report_identity: Parent receipts bind binary and fixture SHA-256; report binds size, byte lengths, event counts, sample order and correctness.
